children: , under the coverage of CLSA, recorded a net loss of RMB314 million in 3Q, narrowing 82% QoQ, mainly due to a product mix shift toward higher-margin vehicle models, which drove vehicle gross margin up 5.9 ppts QoQ to 15.3%.

Battery cost savings and product mix improvement could offset rising memory costs, while management expects gross margin to remain around 15% in 4Q and 2027. CLSA forecast LI AUTO-W to record net profit of RMB25.6 million in 4Q, and revised its full-year net loss forecast for 2026 to RMB4.1 billion from RMB6.3 billion. The broker expected net profit of RMB1.4 billion in 2027, compared with its previous forecast for a net loss of about RMB2 billion.

Meanwhile, it maintained its revenue forecast for 2026 unchanged, while cutting its 2027 and 2028 revenue forecasts by 12% and 14%, respectively. CLSA lowered its Hong Kong stock TP to HKD53 from HKD55, while maintaining the US stock TP for Li Auto Inc.
at USD14, with an Outperform rating.
